Notice under Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR)

Privacy notice

How HYPNOS Srl handles the personal data of people who visit this website and of people who write to us through the contact form, by email, phone or WhatsApp.

Last updated: 1 November 2026 · This is a translation: in case of discrepancy, the Italian version prevails.

1. Data controller

HYPNOS Srl, single-member company
Registered office: Via del Gonfalone 3, 20123 Milano (MI), Italy
VAT no. IT10682130967 · REA MI-2550012
Email: info@hypnosweb.it · PEC (certified email): info@pec.hypnosweb.it
Phone: +39 02 4004 2393

2. What data we process

Data you send us with the contact form

Full name, organisation or department (optional), email address, phone number (optional), the topics you are interested in and the text of your message.

The form does not send any data to a server: it prepares a message that opens in your email app. The data only reaches HYPNOS when you decide to send that email. Until then it stays on your device.

Data you send us by email, PEC, phone or WhatsApp

Your contact details and the information you choose to share with us.

Browsing data

As with any website, the provider hosting the pages automatically logs some technical data about requests (IP address, date and time, page requested, browser type), which is needed to run the site and protect it from abuse. We do not use it to identify visitors.

3. Why we process it and on what legal basis

  • To answer your requests for information, quotes or advice: pre-contractual measures requested by the data subject (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and, for requests made on behalf of an organisation, HYPNOS’s legitimate interest in following up on the contacts it receives (Art. 6(1)(f)).
  • Website security and operation (browsing data): legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)).
  • Legal obligations, if the request leads to a contract (for example tax and accounting obligations): Art. 6(1)(c).

We do not use your data for advertising or newsletters and we do not pass it on to third parties for commercial purposes. We do not take decisions based solely on automated processing.

Providing your data is optional, but without your name, email and message we cannot reply to you.

4. How long we keep it

  • Contact requests: for as long as needed to handle the request and then for no more than 24 months after the last exchange, unless they become part of a contract.
  • Data related to a contract: for 10 years after it ends, as required by Italian civil and tax law.
  • Browsing data: for the period set by the hosting provider for security purposes, usually a few days.

5. Who may process it

Authorised and trained HYPNOS staff, and the providers that supply the services we need, appointed as data processors (Art. 28 GDPR):

  • Cloudflare, Inc.: hosting and delivery of the website pages (browsing data).
  • HYPNOS’s mailbox provider: receiving and storing emails and PEC messages.

Cloudflare is based in the United States and participates in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework; the transfer is based on the European Commission’s adequacy decision (Art. 45 GDPR) and, in addition, on standard contractual clauses.

If you contact us via WhatsApp, that data is also processed by WhatsApp Ireland Ltd under its own privacy policy.

6. Cookies and third-party tools

This website does not use cookies, nor any analytics, profiling or advertising tools. Fonts, libraries and images are served by the site itself, with no requests to external services while you browse. That is why there is no cookie banner.

The links to Google Maps and WhatsApp open third-party websites, whose own privacy policies apply only if you choose to open them.

7. Your rights

You can ask at any time to access, correct or delete your data, restrict its processing, receive it in a portable format and object to processing based on legitimate interest (Arts. 15–22 GDPR). Write to info@hypnosweb.it or by PEC to info@pec.hypnosweb.it: we reply within one month.

If you believe the processing breaches the GDPR, you can lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali, Piazza Venezia 11, 00187 Rome, www.garanteprivacy.it.

8. Changes

We may update this notice, for example if the website’s services change. The date at the top shows the latest version.
